// Generated by `napi build` (pnpm build) from dts-header.txt and the Rust
// sources; do not edit. The declarations below describe the JS wrapper in
// index.js; the interfaces after them come from `#[napi(object)]` structs.
import type { Readable, Writable } from "node:stream"

/** Error codes of the binding (ADR 0008). */
export type ErrorCode =
  | "AUTH_FAILED"
  | "HOST_KEY_REJECTED"
  | "TIMEOUT"
  | "ABORTED"
  | "CONNECT_FAILED"
  | "PROTOCOL"
  | "CHANNEL_OPEN_FAILED"
  | "DISCONNECTED"
  | "SFTP_STATUS"
  | "UNSUPPORTED_KEY"
  | "ENCRYPTED_KEY"
  | "INTERNAL"

/** Shape of every error the binding rejects or throws with (except TypeError for invalid arguments). */
export interface NativeSshError extends Error {
  code: ErrorCode
  /** Machine-readable detail, e.g. the errno, SFTP status or channel-open reason. */
  detail?: string
  /** CONNECT_FAILED only: the OS error number. */
  errno?: number
  /** CONNECT_FAILED only: the errno name, e.g. `ECONNREFUSED`. */
  syscallCode?: string
  /** SFTP_STATUS only: the numeric SFTP status code. */
  sftpStatus?: number
}

export interface ScanOptions {
  host: string
  port: number
  /** Overall deadline for TCP and handshake. Default 10000. */
  timeoutMs?: number
  signal?: AbortSignal
}

export interface ConnectOptions {
  host: string
  port: number
  user: string
  /** Deadline for TCP, handshake, host-key verification and login. Default 20000. */
  readyTimeoutMs?: number
  /** Path of the SSH agent socket; takes precedence over `privateKey` and `password`. */
  agent?: string
  /** PEM or OpenSSH private key. Zero-filled by `connect` in every path. */
  privateKey?: Buffer
  /** Password, also used for keyboard-interactive. Zero-filled by `connect` in every path. */
  password?: Buffer
  /** Bridge server-opened `auth-agent@openssh.com` channels to `agent`. */
  agentForward?: boolean
  /** Aborts TCP, handshake, verification and login with ABORTED. */
  signal?: AbortSignal
}

/** Host-key verifier. Only a verdict of exactly `true` accepts the key. */
export type HostVerifier = (info: HostKeyInfo) => boolean | Promise<boolean>

export interface DisconnectEvent {
  /** `remote`: the server disconnected; `local`: close()/destroy(); `error`: see `code`. */
  reason: "remote" | "local" | "error"
  code?: ErrorCode
}

export interface ExecOptions {
  /** Initial stdin, e.g. a sudo password. Zero-filled by `exec` in every path. */
  stdin?: Buffer
  /** Aborts opening the channel, or cancels the running channel, with ABORTED. */
  signal?: AbortSignal
}

export interface ExecExit {
  code: number | null
  /** Raw signal name, e.g. `TERM`. */
  signal: string | null
  /** `true` when the channel ended because the connection was lost (then `code` is null). */
  disconnected: boolean
}

export interface ExecChannel {
  /**
   * Backpressured: a paused stdout stalls the whole connection. Destroying it
   * (also by leaving a for-await loop or a failed pipeline) releases the stall.
   */
  readonly stdout: Readable
  /** Unbounded; flows while stdout flows. */
  readonly stderr: Readable
  /**
   * Every Buffer written is zero-filled in every path: once the binding copied
   * it, immediately if the stream no longer accepts data, and on exit, cancel
   * or destroy if it is still queued.
   */
  readonly stdin: Writable
  /** Resolves exactly once, after all stdout and stderr data. */
  readonly exit: Promise<ExecExit>
  /** Stops the channel: streams end and `exit` rejects with ABORTED. */
  cancel(): void
  /** Sends CHANNEL_CLOSE; `exit` follows with `disconnected: false` and the exit status, if one arrived. */
  close(): Promise<void>
}

export interface WriteStreamOptions {
  /** File mode, applied on create and through an fchmod after open. */
  mode?: number
  highWaterMark?: number
}

export interface ReadStreamOptions {
  highWaterMark?: number
}

export interface SftpSession {
  createReadStream(path: string, options?: ReadStreamOptions): Readable
  createWriteStream(path: string, options?: WriteStreamOptions): Writable & { bytesWritten?: number }
  end(): Promise<void>
}

export interface Session {
  readonly authInfo: AuthInfo
  readonly closed: boolean
  /**
   * Fires exactly once; late subscribers are notified asynchronously. Returns an
   * unsubscribe function, which also cancels a pending late notification.
   */
  onDisconnect(listener: (event: DisconnectEvent) => void): () => void
  exec(command: string, options?: ExecOptions): Promise<ExecChannel>
  sftp(): Promise<SftpSession>
  /**
   * Graceful close, at most about 5 s (then the socket is shut down); resolves
   * once the connection is gone. Open exec channels end with `disconnected: true`.
   */
  close(): Promise<void>
  /** Synchronous hard stop, safe right before `process.exit()`. */
  destroy(): void
  /** Diagnostics: server-opened channels rejected or bridged. */
  channelStats(): ChannelStats
}

export type Target =
  | "linux-x64-gnu"
  | "linux-arm64-gnu"
  | "linux-x64-musl"
  | "linux-arm64-musl"
  | "darwin-x64"
  | "darwin-arm64"

export declare const SUPPORTED_TARGETS: readonly Target[]

/** The target of the running process, e.g. `linux-x64-gnu`. */
export declare function currentTarget(): string

/** Handshake without login; resolves with the presented host key. */
export declare function scan(options: ScanOptions): Promise<HostKeyInfo>

/** Connects, verifies the host key and logs in. */
export declare function connect(options: ConnectOptions, verifyHost: HostVerifier): Promise<Session>

/** Name of the compiled-in crypto backend. */
export declare function cryptoBackend(): string

/** @internal Undocumented test probe; throws INTERNAL synchronously. */
export declare function __internalPanicProbe(kind: "sync" | "convert"): never
/** @internal Undocumented test probe; rejects with INTERNAL. */
export declare function __internalPanicProbe(
  kind: "async" | "event" | "execReader" | "handler"
): Promise<never>
